query: Consider the Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement between Khronos and Khronos; Does the document state that Confidential Information shall only include technical information?
gold: ”Confidential Information” shall include all technical and non-technical information provided by either party to the other, including but not limited to materials generated by Khronos and by Members on behalf of Khronos, and not specifically designated as non-Confidential by the providing party, including all versions and revisions of draft specifications and any passwords and minutes provided to either Participant or Khronos under this agreement.
rag_answer: No. The document states that “Confidential Information” includes **all technical and non-technical information** provided by either party, not only technical information.
